column1: # Known-red ledger for `cargo test --release --no-fail-fast`.
# Every row is a test that fails on main today, with the bead that owns it.
# scripts/check_known_red.sh compares this file against a real run and fails if
# the two disagree in EITHER direction: a new red is a regression, and a listed
# test that passes means this file is lying about the repo.
# Skipping a red is allowed. Hiding one is not. A row without a bead id is a
# hard error — the point is that every red is owed to somebody.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS (.agent-config-izbto, 2026-09-03): 15 tests were red on
# main and only 2 were tracked. A bare `cargo test` aborts at the first failing
# binary, so the standing count was reported as 1-2 for days while the rest were
# invisible — including a live under-block (6yt2i). Three separate beads each
# re-established their own baseline by hand because there was nothing to read.
# NOTE ON DOCTESTS: CI runs `cargo nextest`, which does not run doctests at all,
# so the progress.rs row below is invisible to CI and only this script sees it.
# test name<TAB>bead<TAB>one-line reason
